title: Phthalocyanine-based covalent organic frameworks: bridging molecular design and catalytic performance in CO2 reduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50692-50713
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06357D, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yingying Li, Haiyan Song, Wenbo Zhu, Wenduo Li, Chao Shuai
The article summarizes synthesis strategies and preparation schemes of phthalocyanine-based covalent organic materials, their application in electrocatalytic and photocatalytic CO2 reduction, existing challenges and future development prospects.
